source: proofs/lem-compcb-row-column-product (af-validated 2026-07-25, 20 nodes taint clean). FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Row-column compressed-product estimate: universal C_rc < infinity and e_rc > 0 such that for e=delta+epsilon <= e_rc, delta-projections P,Q in an extended epsilon-C*-algebra A, n >= 1, and X,Y in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}: ||Co_Q(Y^dagger X) - Y^dagger X|| <= C_rc*e*||Y||*||X||, where Y^dagger X is the ambient product of the 1-by-n row Y^dagger with the n-by-1 column X.
